correctness.rationale: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_skew_moments.py from scratch: ALL CHECKS PASSED for odd n=3..21 (m=2..11, 4092 skew sequences). Reproduced meanE=(m-1)(2m-3), per-lag E[C_k^2]=0 for odd k and 2(n-k)-1 for even k, Var(E) table, and gap -2(m-1)/n^2 exactly as Fractions. Independently recomputed full pairwise E[T_j T_l] matrices for all m<=11: even k equals identity plus anti-identity, odd-k C_k pointwise zero; fiber-pair uniqueness check to m=200 confirms no hidden coincidences. Hand-checked proof steps: reversal identity T_{j'}=(-1)^k T_j, fixed-point-free pairing for odd k (N even), diagonal plus mirror count N+(N-1)=2N-1 for even k, summation to (m-1)(2m-3), and gap algebra all correct. The 'other pairs contribute 0' step is terse in DRAFT but true: completed fiber argument (r(i)=c-|i-c|, fibers {i,g(i)}, constant only at j*=(N-1)/2, pair equality forces l in {j,j'}) holds generally; variance is honestly presented as verified table only, no closed form claimed.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors checked live: Katz-Ramirez 2307.14281 (exact mean/variance/skewness/kurtosis for UNRESTRICTED uniform ensemble over all 2^l sequences) and 2307.14566 (quasi-polynomial central moments, normal limit, unrestricted) contain no skew-symmetric conditioning; Zhang et al. 2504.00987 shows unrestricted optima beat provably optimal skew optima at 99,107,109,113,119 with no distributional formula; Boskovic et al. 1406.5301 warns skew-only solvers need not be globally optimal with no moment theorem; OEIS A102780 stores optimum energies/merit factors to n=66, not distributional moments. Targeted arXiv full-text search for skew-symmetric demerit mean/variance returned no results. Symmetry constraint changes admissible autocorrelation tuples (odd lags forced zero, even-lag second moments 2(n-k)-1 vs unrestricted n-k), so formula is not mechanically implied by unrestricted polynomials. No prior gives the skew-conditional mean or the strict bias inequality.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously proved exact invariant of a natural object: mean demerit/energy over the uniform Golay skew-symmetric Littlewood ensemble at odd n, plus strict bias inequality vs unrestricted mean, plus exact verified variance table for n=3..21. Object was motivated before computation (standard LABS dimension-halving restriction; unexplained Zhang skew-suboptimality; Boskovic warning; partitioned-skew/Thompson-sampling solver design) and value is not known or mechanically implied. Future solver/baseline work can directly reuse the precise rational forms and bias gap. Per SCOPE value standard this qualifies without a new general theorem; certification alone is not the value — the motivated exact mean/bias lemma is. Bounded variance table is honestly labeled as table-only and does not erase the general mean theorem.
